# Security

Wingman records meetings, so privacy problems matter. If you find a security or privacy
issue — for example a way Wingman could leak audio, transcripts, meeting titles or
voiceprints, record when it shouldn't, or accept an update it shouldn't — please report it
privately instead of opening a public issue:

**[Report a vulnerability privately](https://github.com/daniel-wing/wingman-beta/security/advisories/new)**
(a free GitHub account is needed).

Say what you found, how to reproduce it, and which Wingman version you use (Settings →
About). Please don't attach real meeting content or logs from real meetings.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets fixes. Since 0.8.0 Wingman updates itself, so most people
get a fix soon after it's published.

## What to expect

Wingman is a small project maintained in spare time: expect a first answer within a week.
Fixes ship as a new release, and you'll be credited in its notes if you'd like.
